# Syenxa Tech

> Syenxa Tech is an AI Automation Agency specializing in custom AI Voice Calling Agents, omnichannel AI Chatbots, Next.js Web Development, and Digital Marketing Automation.

## Main Services
- [AI Calling Agents](https://www.syenxatech.com/ai-calling-agents): Autonomous 24/7 AI voice agents for sales calls, lead qualification, and appointment booking.
- [Custom Website Development](https://www.syenxatech.com/website-development): High-performance Next.js websites, SaaS user interfaces, and custom web applications.
- [AI Chatbots](https://www.syenxatech.com/ai-chatbots): Customer support and sales chatbots across WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, TikTok, and web.
- [AI Digital Marketing](https://www.syenxatech.com/digital-marketing): Performance marketing and AI lead generation automation.
- [Services Overview](https://www.syenxatech.com/services): Enterprise AI integration and software engineering.

## Industry Use Cases
- [Healthcare AI Scheduling](https://www.syenxatech.com/use-cases/doctor): Patient pre-screening, appointment reminders, and automated clinic front desk.
- [Real Estate Voice Agents](https://www.syenxatech.com/use-cases/real-estate): 24/7 lead qualification and automated property viewing scheduling.
- [Fitness & Gym Automation](https://www.syenxatech.com/use-cases/gym): Class bookings, membership renewals, and re-engagement campaigns.
- [Beauty & Spa Booking](https://www.syenxatech.com/use-cases/beauty-salon): Salon booking management and waitlist automation.
